_doc: Numbers the pacing simulator cannot derive from planet data. constants: id -> {value, how}; 'how' says how the value was measured, or says ESTIMATE when it was not. 'Bot run' means the fresh autoplay run of Nov 10 kept in tools/pace_sim/calibration_bot_run.log (godot --headless --path . -- --fresh --autoplay --time-scale=8; 83 game minutes). side_events: stats the model does not simulate but the bot raises on the side; each reaches 1 at first_s and then rises by 1 every every_s (0 = once). build_sets_flag: yard build id -> the flag building it sets (shared code, not planet content). bot_mirror: lists the full-game bot hardcodes (tools/autoplay.gd), kept here so the policy scripts name no content; ids a planet does not have are skipped. Re-measure after any change to the bot, the hand loop or the crew: see tools/pace_sim/README.md.

start_delay_s.how: Bot run: the third bin load lands at 84 s, but three modelled loads take 44 s. The difference is the landing (pod, first message, first steps). Inferred, not logged directly.

hand_duty.how: Share of scoop pulses that find a piece. Fitted together with seek_s_per_volume and trip_overhead_s to the bot run's first three hexes (7.5, 14.5, 19.6 min).

seek_s_per_volume.how: Seconds Lumi spends finding and facing junk per unit of volume, whatever the scoop speed. Fitted to the bot run at minutes 45-60, when Haul Bugs carry the bales and Lumi only scoops: about 2 min a hex by hand.

beam_exponent.how: ESTIMATE. How much a wider or longer beam cuts the seek time: seek / (beam area ratio ^ exponent). Not measured; the bot run cannot separate it.

trip_overhead_s.how: Seconds per bin trip on top of walking (turning, lining up, the bin swallowing). Fitted to the bot run's first three hexes.

bale_handle_s.how: Seconds per bale on top of the 1.7 s press (picking it up or setting it down). Fitted with trip_overhead_s.

bench_gap_s.how: Copied from tools/autoplay.gd _manage: the bot walks back to the bench at most every 20 s.

yard_offset_m.how: Bot run: Lumi's logged positions while working the first hex are 5-8 m from where he delivers.

yard_parts.how: Bot run: 70 Parts on hand at minute 2.0, from buried parts dug up in the start yard.

yard_finds.how: Bot run: the 'find 2 parts' goal is met by minute 2.4.

yard_finds_s.how: Bot run: found before the first upgrade at 86 s (the goal folds into that step). Exact second not logged.

parts_luck.how: Parts found in scooped junk against the expectation from data (drop chance x the rarity table's mean value, about 120 a hex). Bot run: about 415 Parts outside the yard by minute 33 and about 1,060 by minute 83, half of what the tables predict. Parts come in rare big finds, so runs differ a lot: base level 2 came at 33.0 min in this run and 52.6 min on Nov 9.

buried_find_share.how: ESTIMATE. Share of a hex's buried parts the player digs up. Not measured.

crew_travel_s_per_ring.how: Seconds a cleaner robot spends driving per hex, per ring of distance between the frontier and the base. Bot run, cleaner output per robot in four windows (minutes 24-33, 33-44, 45-60, 60-70): 0.35, 0.28, 0.30 and 0.19 hexes a minute, which fits 32-55 s a ring.

haul_overhead_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds a hauler spends loading and unloading per trip. Not measured.

recycle_every.how: Copied from tools/autoplay.gd _shop: the bot sends every 4th bale to the recycler.

robot_cost_growth.how: Copied from robots/fleet.gd build_cost, where it is a literal: each robot of a type costs 1.35x the one before. It belongs in the robots table.

garden_time_share.how: Bot run: 21 of the 57 one-minute snapshots from minute 27 on show Lumi watering instead of cleaning.

seed_fetch_s.how: Bot run: the seed tin is picked up about 2 min after the seed step appears (signal after 75 s, then the walk).

plant_seed_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds of garden time to plant one seed. Not measured.

robot_plant_seed_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds a planter robot needs per seed, driving included. Not measured.

drip_hexes.how: ESTIMATE. Hexes one watering robot keeps watered. Not measured.

bot_to_player.how: docs/PLAN.md section 3: the bot plays about twice as fast as a new player.

shards_found.how: ESTIMATE: the bot run does not log shard reads.

cats_petted.how: ESTIMATE: the bot run does not log it.
